handoff: All review#1 points closed (S1 post-claim re-read + race test, F1 restart-at-review + restartStepOf units, S3-S9); AC1-AC4 traced; e2e 73/1 skip/0. Minor only: concurrent staging sweep, null do_instead on story view --web, needs_removed hint lost, untested strict lastBoundary / null-branch orient rendering. One flake in takeover-record-lost (passed 3/3 isolated).

findings.title: recoverPlace sweeps every .unpack-* folder regardless of pid
findings.detail:
stageRecordSync runs in prepareRecord before the claim, so a second concurrent `story checkout` of the same story on the same machine can delete the first one's live staging folder (or swap a .replaced back mid-placeStaged); the first then fails loudly with record_place_failed while holding the claim. Recoverable, rare.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Sweep only folders whose pid suffix is not alive, or sweep only after the claim.

findings.title: --web refusal has no do_instead for a story without a branch
findings.detail:
report.pr_command is now null for a record-only story, so the no_url refusal carries do_instead null (P8: human hints go in do_instead).
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Fall back to cmd.storyView(story) or cmd.status().

findings.title: Non-corrupt parse failures (needs_removed) print as 'cannot be read' without details
findings.detail:
Every non-ok parse becomes corrupt with no error details; a needs_removed result loses its norn upgrade hint.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Pass the parse error and its hint for each reason.

findings.title: lastBoundary strict mode untested
findings.detail:
A cheap seam exists: a store integration test calling lastBoundary(root, 'refs/heads/nope', key, null, {strict:true}) expecting a throw, and the lenient call returning null.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Add that store test; the checkout wrapping can stay untested.

findings.title: Nullable branch/pr_command rendering untested
findings.detail:
The 'no branch (held from its record, B33)' and 'no PR without a branch' lines and pr_command null have no test (story-view/view tests cover branched stories only). The record-only inbox item has no core unit test, only the integration test.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Add a formatStoryView case and a unitInboxItem unit case.

findings.title: 'new' frontmatter case is labelled S5 but tests the not-active skip; its scenario needs a hand push
findings.detail:
Intake commits with push:false, so a remote branch with status new exists only after a hand push; the test proves what it asserts (record_lost false, no receipt, tick story.start), but not workflow_invalid.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Relabel it as the not-started path.

findings.title: Slice units of a lost story are not rebuilt (untested)
findings.detail:
Only the story unit gets a new round; a story lost at a slices step has no test of what happens to its slice units.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Note it for a later slice or add a case.

findings.title: User-facing text cites a spec id (B33); B33/10-R3-F2 fallout carried in this slice
findings.detail:
Consistent with B33; requested by the supervisor.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Optional: drop '(B33)' from the item title.
